origin: Self-trained in joustix's own simulation (tools/neural/joustix_lab.c linked against game.o). No third-party data or weights.
inputs: game_policy_features() in src/game.c: 47 floats in the fixed 320x180 logical units
outputs: 6 logits: direction {left, none, right} x flap {no, yes}; argmax each tick

training.method: evolution strategies (antithetic, rank-shaped, Adam, sigma 0.05, lr 0.02, pop 64, 48 shared waves per generation, difficulty and wave 1-12 drawn from the seed)
stages: from scratch, 60 s episodes, death penalty 1.0: selected generation 75 (selection 85.2%)
continued 200 generations, 120 s episodes, death penalty 3.0, after a diagnosis showed every death was a joust lost to a higher enemy: selected generation 150
training.reward: share of the wave's points earned + (1 + up to 0.5 for a faster clear) - death penalty

evaluation_episode: seed S+k, difficulty k%3, wave 1+(k/3)%12; ends on a clear, a lost rider or 120 s

selection.rule: highest clean-clear rate; progress breaks ties; then the smaller network

held_out.ship_rule: clean-clear rate beats the autopilot with non-overlapping Wilson intervals, rider-loss rate not worse (non-overlapping), no wave band worse: met
